thread:
Noah R: Heads up: we have a new inbound from HealthCore — they want an observability pane that surfaces cost by route and flags sudden token-cost regressions tied to eval prompt sets. Timebox: pilot in 3 weeks. Need quick scope.
Sana M: are they ok with estimated cost attribution?
HealthCore Rep: (via email) estimated attribution ok for triage; exact billing still via invoices.
Devon H: tech reality: we capture route, model, tokens_estimated, and eval_set_id in logs. We can join tokens to eval_set if they pass eval_set_id. Missing piece: UI to select eval set and filter cost/time series.
Talia Z: propose minimal MVP: 1) Dashboard: per-route p50/p95 latency, error-rate, estimated token cost per hour; 2) Evaluations filter: ability to select eval_set and see associated cost/time series + top failing prompts; 3) Tracing hooks: click-to-trace from spike, sampling bumping during spike windows.
Noah R: retention ask? HealthCore asked 45d aggregated metrics and 30d traces.
Devon H: 45d aggregates ok, 30d traces requires enterprise add-on or private. Recommend 14d hosted traces + on-demand rehydrate for 30d for pilot.
Sana M: action items: Devon  instrument eval_set join and surface top failing prompts; Talia  dashboard mock + eval filter UX; Noah  customer communication + retention proposal.
infra-bot: scheduled: observability/healthcore-feature -> staging 2026-04-10T04:00Z
Talia Z: launch gates: (1) select eval_set and display associated token-cost time series; (2) click-to-trace for recent data; (3) sampling override infra in place.
Noah R: timeline: MVP in 2 sprints, follow-up for exports and 30d rehydrate later.
Devon H: risks: eval_set cardinality may be high; recommend limit to last 20 eval sets in UI by default.
Sana M: will coordinate with HealthCore PM re: data model and confirm acceptability of estimated costs.
Noah R: thanks everyone. I'll post summary to the roadmap doc.
